verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a synchronous webhook for real-time authorization approve/decline decisions, showing webhook-based event subscription exists for Issuing, but the pack lacks documentation of general asynchronous webhook events (e.g., card.created, dispute.updated) or a broader events/webhooks API for Issuing objects. Missing for 10: full webhook event catalog for Issuing objects, async webhook setup docs, and independent confirmation of reliability/coverage.
